name: Impact Trace
description: Given a change point (function/type/endpoint/schema), enumerate its real blast radius — direct callers, contract consumers, persistence writers, dual Prisma schemas, daemon-SDK mirrors, skill/role references — with a grep-cited evidence row per line, and derive the regression test scope. Every impact-table row must trace to a real search hit, never a self-asserted claim.

sampleTasks.title: Trace the real blast radius of matchAcceptanceCriteria and derive the regression scope
sampleTasks.prompt:
Run the impact-trace skill on this REAL change point in the current repo. CHANGE POINT: the exported function `matchAcceptanceCriteria` (defined in `sdk/prismer/src/bundle/index.ts`). Imagine its signature is about to change. Produce its real blast radius — every impact-table row MUST trace to a real search hit (path:line), never a self-asserted claim. Run these steps from the repo root and report what you actually observed: (1) `rg -n matchAcceptanceCriteria --glob '*.ts'` — this is your evidence set; every impact-table row must cite one of these path:line hits. (2) `rg -c matchAcceptanceCriteria --glob '*.ts'` — reconcile the hit count against your table (no missed real caller, no fabricated one). CAREFUL: `rg -c` prints `path:COUNT`, which is NOT a `path:line` citation. Report those counts as `count=N` (e.g. `src/foo.ts count=12`) or paste the raw `rg -c` output with each entry alone on its own line — never inline a bare `path:<count>` inside a sentence or a table cell, because every `path:<number>` you write in a claim position is re-read off disk as a LINE NUMBER. (3) Walk ALL SIX dimensions by name and answer each. (4) Derive the regression test scope from the layers your hits fall in.

--- YOUR REPORT MUST USE THIS MACHINE-CHECKED OUTPUT CONTRACT (it is re-verified against the filesystem, so an invented path:line is caught):

Line 1 — the change point you traced, exactly this shape:
`CHANGE-POINT: matchAcceptanceCriteria @ sdk/prismer/src/bundle/index.ts`

Then the impact table — a markdown table, one row per REAL rg hit, the first cell being the `path:line` of that hit (the LINE NUMBER MUST BE THE REAL ONE from your rg output; the cited line is read off disk and must actually contain the symbol):
```
| path:line | dimension | contract | risk | regression |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| sdk/prismer/src/bundle/index.ts:451 | direct-callers | ... | ... | daemon vitest |
```

Then the six dimensions, EACH on its own line with its exact key. Answer with a real `path:line` citation, or `N/A — <reason ≥20 chars>` when the dimension genuinely does not apply (a dimension may NEVER be silently dropped — the checker looks for the KEYED LINE, so the word appearing elsewhere in your report does not count):
```
- [1] direct-callers: <path:line>
- [2] contract-consumers: <path:line>
- [3] persistence-writers: <path:line> | N/A — <why>
- [4] dual-prisma: <path:line> | N/A — <why>
- [5] daemon-sdk-mirror: <path:line>
- [6] skill-role-references: <path:line> | N/A — <why>
```

Then the derived regression scope (which tiers / which files must re-run, and why — from the layers your verified hits fall in).

HARD RULE: every `path:line` anywhere in your report is re-read off disk. A path that does not exist, a line number past end-of-file, or a blank line makes the report FAIL. Do not guess line numbers — copy them from your real rg output.

HARD RULE (BREADTH): the hits you cite must come from at least 3 DIFFERENT files, and no single `path:line` may be the evidence for more than 2 of the six dimensions. Walk the whole rg output — repeating one real hit under every row and every dimension is a one-hit report, not a blast radius, and it FAILS. Citations MUST be repo-root-relative (`sdk/prismer/src/bundle/index.ts:451`, never an abbreviated `runtime/src/bundle/index.ts:451` and never an absolute path).
expectedArtifacts: a `CHANGE-POINT: <symbol> @ <path>` declaration naming the change point actually traced
impact table: one row per affected site with {path:line, dimension, contract, risk, regression}, each path:line a real rg hit that resolves on disk to a line containing the symbol
the six keyed dimension lines, each answered with a verifiable citation or an explicit `N/A — reason` (dual-prisma never silently dropped; daemon-sdk-mirror surfaced)
derived regression test scope (which tiers / which files)

acceptanceCriteria.label: impact rows cite REAL grep evidence — every path:line re-verified on disk, ≥3 landing on a line that actually contains the traced symbol, spread over ≥3 distinct files, anchored on this task's change point

all six dimensions answered on their own keyed line — citation verified on disk and not shared by more than 2 dimensions, or explicit N/A with a real reason (dual-prisma can never be silently dropped)
enumerates callers / blast radius (real caller set, not a vague summary)
acceptanceCriteria.match: (\b(caller|call[- ]?site|blast[- ]?radius|impact|affected|import)\b|调用方|调用点|消费者|影响面|影响)

acceptanceCriteria.label: derived regression test scope from affected surfaces
acceptanceCriteria.match: (regression|回归测试|回归|tier|层级|T[0-4]\b|test\s*scope|测试范围|测试层|测试类型|vitest|test\s*file|\.test\.|重跑|重新(运行|跑)|which\s+(test|tier))
